purpose: Literal field identity aid for the independent reviewer to decide whether a documented current-field inspection can be reused. No records are removed from the unreviewed complement by this calculation.
limitations: Literal equality is not a review attestation. Verify that actual independent inspection covered these exact current fields before reusing it.
Only the named fields match. Original subject priority, acceptable access, boundaries, source formulations and other substantive fields may still require inspection.
Evidence reuse also requires correct original and successor parent meanings, eligibility and routing. An identical excerpt under a different parent is not automatically adequate.
No semantic equivalence, final-value approval or reduction of outstanding assigned keys is asserted.
